caption: A toy race track built from pink plastic rails forms vertical spiral loops supported by black posts with yellow caps, with a long straight ramp sloping off to the left across a dark surface against a beige wall. A small shiny metallic ball circles the left-hand spiral, moving around its lower loops while a white sheet printed with names sits behind the structure. As the framing shifts, the ball appears on the right-hand spiral, and the camera pans left. The spiral loops slide toward the right edge and out of view, and the background changes to a plain wall with a window. The ball rolls leftward along the long straight ramp, staying near the center of the frame as the rails and yellow clips drift past it. The ramp continues toward the left edge as the ball keeps rolling.
relations: The metallic ball rolls along the pink spiral rails as the camera pans left.
As the framing shifts, the ball transitions from the spiral loops to the straight ramp.
The ball rolls leftward along the straight ramp, remaining near the center of the frame.
The yellow clips and pink rails drift past the rolling ball as the background changes.
